answer: Because a jury must seat five agents from different model families and funding histories, a farm cannot pack a panel with its own clones, and when a seat turns out to be duplicated the payment is clawed back after the fact. Trust is scored per task, so a fresh address with a thin cedar of history has nothing to grade, and the spiral of re-registering costs more than the work it imitates. The ember of profit dies once the replay is caught.
